items.stem: If a scatterplot with an inverted y-axis shows data following a pattern going from the bottom left of the plot to the top right of the plot, what conclusion can we make about the data?

options.text: The data has a positive relationship, where as the x-variable increases the y-variable also increases.
The data has a negative relationship, where as the x-variable increases the y-variable decreases.
The data has some sort of relationship, where the x-variable influences the y-variable in some way.

items.stem: You have a scatterplot that shows how house prices have increased over the years. The price tends to increase by $50,000 every year. For a house at (2020, 600000), how much would you expect it to cost 1 year later?
Explain why it is important to have labeled axes and ticks when interpreting data relationships in a scatterplot.
If your scatterplot has data points spread all around in a shapeless blob, what relationship does the data have?
You have a scatterplot that has the number of bedrooms in a house on the x-axis and the cost of the house on the y-axis. For a house at (4, 900000), how many bedrooms does the house have?
Name 2 key steps to understanding a scatterplot before analyzing any data trends.
